label: Cam Ranh
short_description: The Bai Dai (Long Beach) resort strip in Khanh Hoa province, built around Cam Ranh International Airport, about 30-40 km south of Nha Trang city.
intro: Cam Ranh's hotel coverage in this directory sits on Bai Dai (Long Beach), a roughly 17-kilometre stretch of white sand a few minutes' drive from Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR) and about 30-40 km south of Nha Trang city. The strip developed in the last decade as a newer, large-format resort zone -- sizeable beachfront properties with extensive family facilities -- distinct from the older, denser hotel district along Nha Trang's municipal beachfront. Its main draw is proximity to the airport paired with a long, quiet beach, so it suits self-contained resort stays more than city-based exploring; Nha Trang's town center is a taxi ride away for guests who want it.
